environment: Node test runner, python3, scratch git repos via cli-runner, branches.py from the slice branch

cases.title: Each table command runs and prints a formatted name
cases.when: Run the five name commands in the table with sample ids (slice, milestone, e2e, e2e-area, state, attempt)
cases.then: Exit 0, JSON with ok true and a branch under feature/
cases.expected: Exit 0, JSON with ok true and a branch under feature/
cases.actual: All six exit 0; branches feature/S-025, feature/M-1, feature/M-1-e2e, feature/M-1-e2e-api, feature/state-<ts>, feature/S-025-attempt-2; repo tree unchanged

cases.title: Table holds eight placeholders in order; missing --id or --area fails
cases.when: Parse table rows; run name --kind slice without --id; e2e-area without --area
cases.then: Eight rows; non-zero exit with no branch printed
cases.expected: Eight rows; non-zero exit with no branch printed
cases.actual: Eight rows found; both bad calls exit non-zero with no branch

cases.title: Slice row command prints the formatted slice name
cases.then: feature/S-025 with custom format; sdlc/S-025 by default
cases.expected: feature/S-025 with custom format; sdlc/S-025 by default

cases.title: Run row: list --kind run gives runs in numeric order, last is newest
cases.given: Branches sdlc/run-1, run-2, run-10, other/run-99, custom format with feature/run-4, and a repo with none
cases.then: Last entry is run-10 (not run-2); format respected; empty list for none
cases.expected: Last entry is run-10 (not run-2); format respected; empty list for none
cases.actual: Entries run-1, run-2, run-10 in numeric order; feature/run-4 only under the custom format; empty list when none; exit 0 always

cases.title: parse prints kind and ids for a loop branch and kind null for a foreign branch
cases.then: kind slice with id for the loop branch; kind null for others
cases.expected: kind slice with id for the loop branch; kind null for others

cases.title: Hostile branch names never crash parse or yield a loop kind
cases.given: Attack corpus families flag-like-values, traversal, control-chars, unicode-confusables, unicode-whitespace, injection, oversized, format-strings; NUL argument
cases.then: Exit 0 or 2, no traceback, kind null; NUL cannot reach the process
cases.expected: Exit 0 or 2, no traceback, kind null; NUL cannot reach the process
cases.actual: All entries pass in 8 families; NUL gives spawnError

seeds.title: _common.md says parse prints null; it prints JSON with kind null
seeds.detail: The Branch names bullet says parse prints 'null' for a foreign branch. The command prints a JSON object with "kind": null. The same bullet says name 'prints' a name, but the command prints JSON with a branch field. A reader may look for the bare word null or a bare name. Say 'prints kind null' and 'the branch field'.
